summary.headline: Astrological Interrogations 101–120
summary.text: Astrological interrogations 101–120, with questions about wells and buried gold, absent persons, runaway slaves, inheritances, lawsuits, love and hate, illness, truth, rumors, profit, property, death, letters, requests, affection, sales, and moving house, cross-referenced to Venetian and Parisian codices.
